_editing: Zero-fee and offline giving channels. `handle` null hides the detail line and shows 'contact us for details' instead — safer than publishing a wrong account. QR images go in public/giving/ and are referenced as /giving/<file>.png.

feeNote.en: No processing fee — the full amount reaches the seva.

instructions.en: Send from your bank's app using the details above. Add the fund name in the memo so the treasurer can allocate it correctly.
instructions.mr: आपल्या बँकेच्या ॲपमधून पाठवा. निधीचे नाव memo मध्ये लिहा.

feeNote.en: Venmo charges no fee for personal transfers.

instructions.en: Add the fund name in the note. Please send as a payment to a friend, not a purchase.

feeNote.en: No processing fee. Best channel for large gifts.

instructions.en: Make the check payable to Shri Gajanan Seva and mail it to the mandir, or hand it to a trustee on a darshan day. Write the fund name on the memo line. For any additional information email info@shrigajananseva.org.
instructions.mr: धनादेश 'Shri Gajanan Seva' या नावाने काढावा.

feeNote.en: Often the most tax-efficient way to make a large gift.

instructions.en: Appreciated stock and DAF grants are accepted. Email charity@shrigajananseva.org and the treasurer will send transfer instructions.
instructions.mr: अधिक माहितीसाठी charity@shrigajananseva.org वर संपर्क साधा.
